feature_contract.goal: Keep full +TIME sprite and numeric ownership coherent across completed explicit D3DX Flush, subsequent queued/direct Draw and failed native submissions; prevent an already submitted batch from lending stale queue permission to a different producer.
feature_contract.scope_boundary: Only the existing DX9Ex R84 stage-extension D3DX producer/batch path; protect GOAL family, D3DX native failure behavior, ordinary HUD, road/cars, FFB/input, SkyGlow, frozen DXVK and R26_SAFE.
trace_stages: Six original +TIME sprite and number parent E8 calls assign StageExtensionTime and tag appended SpriteNodes.
R64 hooked ID3DXSprite Begin/Draw/Flush/End separately tracks native pending triangle batches and producer homogeneous status.
R84 ScreenHud direct and queued Draw/Flush ownership enters stereo eye composition while unknown or failed batches retain native D3DX fallback.
subcomponents: Reset the exact +TIME/GOAL queued submission authorization when the game's own ID3DXSprite::Flush successfully consumes the tracked native batch, alongside its pending producer and draw counter.
Allow the next exact successful producer Draw to re-arm queue submission through the already source-proven Begin/Draw contract, without touching the separate native Draw-failure/End/Reset fallback.
Preserve all six original +TIME sprite and numeric owner paths, independent GOAL GPU batching and original user game/HUD/FFB/SkyGlow/desktop behavior.

acceptance_items.expected_behavior: Failed Flush keeps unknown batch fallback, original Draw failure isolation remains intact, foreign and mixed sprites never claim a +TIME or GOAL Flush, and native HRESULTs are unchanged.

acceptance_items.expected_behavior: DX9Ex Active Windows x86 game x64 host package and Domain/Full Source/HUD affected gates all pass on one validation-bearing exact SHA; Quest3 testing is separate.

diagnosis.root_cause: ID3DXSprite::Flush success discarded PendingDraws/producer with ForgetBatch(), but did not clear StageBoundaryReady previously armed by queued +TIME/GOAL, allowing a later Draw in the same queue to encounter an obsolete submission privilege.
diagnosis.original_evidence: Original game +TIME producer hooks cover 0x9898E/0x98A36/0x98AC6 and glyph calls 0x989AD/0x98A89/0x98A10; R64 ID3DXSprite vtable 8-13 hooks control deferred GPU submissions.
source_trace: Original six 0x989xx +TIME parent E8 calls preserve immediate numeric and appended SpriteNode source tags.
R64 ID3DXSprite DrawDest tracks a homogeneous native batch and BeforeQueueNode/BeforeQueueEnd manage queue-exit submissions.
FlushDest returned success and called ForgetBatch while leaving StageBoundaryReady set; only a new correctly tagged Draw may re-arm queue ownership after the fix.
alternatives_rejected: Do not add unconditional per-sprite Flush or relabel mixed unknown D3DX batches.
Do not suppress +TIME/GOAL effects, globally tag alpha/XYZRHW or change timer/game logic.
diagnosis.fix_evidence: In the final C++ source at b1ef6c77, successful original ID3DXSprite::Flush retires PendingDraws, producer provenance and StageBoundaryReady together. The existing failed-Draw quarantine is unchanged. Changed-area positive and destructive-mutation regression is active on later test-only 9db61c7f.
diagnosis.negative_test_evidence: Changed-area +TIME/GOAL ownership verifier including successful Flush stale-boundary mutation and failed/mixed/stale/foreign native D3DX Draw paths passed; four required full GitHub Actions workflows all succeeded on material source SHA b1ef6c77. Follow-up test-only 9db61c7f passed DX9Ex Active 5/5 and Domain 1/1 without changing C++ runtime sources.
diagnosis.eye_ownership: Only successfully drawn, source-owned homogeneous stage batches can carry ScreenHud semantics into R84 left/right rendering; failed or foreign GPU batches fall back to original D3DX semantics.
